commentary: Directional accuracy (48.6%) near 50% is mathematically consistent with Eugene Fama's Weak-Form Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) for liquid commodity futures. However, the deep LSTM + Attention network captures multi-scale volatility clustering and non-linear momentum, achieving an R² of 0.435 and reducing test MAPE by -163.6% compared to the linear ARIMA baseline (14.86% vs 5.64%).
